typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	tblOTCFXRates_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		BR as string,
		PERIOD1 as string,
		TERMS as string,
		CCY as string,
		SPOTRATE_8 as integer,
		LSTMNTDATE as timestamp
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> opicsplusdbfxrrevp
opicsplusdbfxrrevp sink(input(
		BR as string,
		PERIOD1 as string,
		TERMS as string,
		CCY as string,
		SPOTRATE_8 as integer,
		LSTMNTDATE as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy'
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		BR,
		PERIOD1,
		TERMS,
		CCY,
		SPOTRATE_8,
		LSTMNTDATE),
	partitionFileNames:[($tblOTCFXRates_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> tblOTCFXRates
